_comment: Copy this file to contextforge.config.json and fill in your values. Never commit your real config — it's gitignored.

llm._comment: Supported backends: openai, anthropic, grok, ollama, custom
llm._ollama_example: If using ollama, set backend to 'ollama' and set ollama_url below
llm._custom_example: If using a custom endpoint, set backend to 'custom' and set custom_endpoint below

dm._comment: Filled in automatically during first-launch onboarding. You can set these manually to skip it.

memory._comment_player_id: Change this if you want multiple player profiles on the same machine.
